statement.sql:
Select max(P.ActivityCode) as ActivityCode, max(P.ProgramName) as ProgramName, max(LTPT.DisplayValue) as DisplaySection, max(LTT.[Description]) as Task, max(LTS.DisplayValue) as TaskStatus, TPORO.ProgramId, P.ActivityCode, count(*) as TaskNotstartedCount, 0 as TaskInProgressCount, max(T.TaskTypeCode) as TaskTypeCode, max(cast(T.ClientTaskId as varchar(36))) as ClientTaskId From Tasks T Inner Join RelTaskProcessTask RTPT on RTPT.TaskId = T.TaskId Inner Join TaskProcess TP on TP.TaskProcessId = RTPT.TaskProcessId Inner Join TaskProcessOtherRelatedObjects TPORO on TPORO.TaskProcessId = TP.TaskProcessID Inner Join lookuptaskprocesstype LTPT on LTPT.LookupCode = TP.TaskProcessTypeCode Join ( Select PMAX.ProgramId, max(PMAX.ProgramInstance) as ProgramInstance, max(PMAX.ActivityCode) as ActivityCode, max(PMAX.ProgramShortName) as ProgramName From Programs PMAX group by ProgramId ) P on P.ProgramId = TPORO.ProgramId Join LookupTaskType LTT on LTT.LookupCode = T.TaskTypeCode Join LookUpTaskStatus LTS on LTS.LookupCode = T.TaskStatusCode
T.TaskStatusCode = 1
group by TPORO.ProgramId, P.ActivityCode, TP.TaskProcessTypeCode, T.TaskTypeCode
Union
Select max(P.ActivityCode) as ActivityCode, max(P.ProgramName) as ProgramName, max(LTPT.DisplayValue) as DisplaySection, max(LTT.[Description]) as Task, max(LTS.DisplayValue) as TaskStatus, TPORO.ProgramId, P.ActivityCode, 0 as TaskNotstartedCount, count(*) as TaskInProgressCount, max(T.TaskTypeCode) as TaskTypeCode, max(cast(T.ClientTaskId as varchar(36))) as ClientTaskId From Tasks T Inner Join RelTaskProcessTask RTPT on RTPT.TaskId = T.TaskId Inner Join TaskProcess TP on TP.TaskProcessId = RTPT.TaskProcessId Inner Join TaskProcessOtherRelatedObjects TPORO on TPORO.TaskProcessId = TP.TaskProcessID Inner Join lookuptaskprocesstype LTPT on LTPT.LookupCode = TP.TaskProcessTypeCode Join ( Select PMAX.ProgramId, max(PMAX.ProgramInstance) as ProgramInstance, max(PMAX.ActivityCode) as ActivityCode, max(PMAX.ProgramShortName) as ProgramName From Programs PMAX group by ProgramId ) P on P.ProgramId = TPORO.ProgramId Join LookupTaskType LTT on LTT.LookupCode = T.TaskTypeCode Join LookUpTaskStatus LTS on LTS.LookupCode = T.TaskStatusCode
T.TaskStatusCode = 2
group by TPORO.ProgramId, P.ActivityCode, TP.TaskProcessTypeCode, T.TaskTypeCode
Order by P.ActivityCode
